cto_scoring_notes.o4-mini_discrepancy: o4-mini scored 83 (FAIL) while GPT-4.1 and Gemini both scored 93+ (PASS) on identical v1.1 documents. The 'major' technical feasibility issues flagged by o4-mini appear to be implementation-time decisions rather than design flaws: (1) shadcn version 'v0.4+' is a reasonable stable range, (2) 20+ components is realistic for a full enterprise dashboard, (3) Platform Selector is UI-only - actual data integration is separate. The o4-mini subagent may have applied overly strict criteria. However, per protocol, o4-mini's score of 83 = FAIL blocks the gate.
